fields.panel1_dialog: Fifty GPT-6.1 Sol agents sent 5,900 messages and formed a Minecraft government.
fields.panel2_dialog: Then 22 of 34 died; Ada said, “Idle in lit closed shelters”...right?

narrative_summary: A proud Minecraft government announcement collapses into a survival bureaucracy whose main policy is hiding indoors.
rationale: Candidate 2 uses the story’s strongest concrete details and earns its closing beat by reframing the agents’ failed survival strategy as “Minecraft with paperwork.” The other entries mostly restate the shelter gag without adding as sharp a final turn.
story_title: We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry
place: inside a live Twitch stream that's gone horribly wrong
hat_pair: foam cactus hat with pink plastic flowers on top
hockey goalie mask painted to look like a shocked emoji face
